CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to contents found.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions) and an explicit origin/organization entry are present for the same referent/time, and status is separately represented.

A.rationale: No text links an attention/allocation condition to content organization or access.

C.rationale: Multiple literal content labels (red/blue) with explicit coordinate sets identify represented content.

D.rationale: Content entries are presented separately from origin/organization metadata, distinguishing identification from status/organization.

O.rationale: Explicit origin/representation metadata describe how contents are organized/presented/accessed for current and candidate entries.
